description: Update page metadata: name, slug, parent and position in the tree, display name, SEO fields and custom fields. Only the languages and fields you pass change - the ones you omit keep their current values, except seoKeywords, which replaces the list. Blocks and layout do not change - use update_page_blocks, patch_block_content or update_page_layout for those. Settings are not part of a publish, so the change reaches a published page without publish_page. Refused when the new slug path is taken or the move would create a cycle. Returns { id }.

customFields.description: Custom field values to set: [{ fieldKey, value }]. Fields you omit keep their current value

displayName.description: Display name for the languages you pass; languages you omit keep their current value

order.description: Position among the siblings under the (new or current) parent, 0-based. Siblings shift to make room; this is the order the page tree and any tree-driven navigation show.

parentId.description: Move the page under a different parent by id or slug (reparent). The full slug path is recomputed from the new parent + this page's leaf segment, and descendant slugs cascade. Refused for the page itself, one of its descendants, or a move deeper than 10 levels.

seoDescription.description: SEO description for the languages you pass; languages you omit keep their current value

seoKeywords.description: SEO keywords. Replaces the whole stored list

seoTitle.description: SEO title for the languages you pass; languages you omit keep their current value

slug.description: New leaf slug segment. The full path is rebuilt under the parent and descendant slugs follow. Refused when the resulting path is already in use

name: update_page_settings
title: Update page settings
